name: Well of wonders
review:
Well of Wonders is a wishing-well slot with occurrence wins, respins, multipliers, wilds and a fairy.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with a 2,280x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

Wins are counted by how many matching symbols appear, not by paylines, and the fairy feature can add wilds and multipliers. Low volatility keeps it relaxed.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
